comments.author: 1XERO1
comments.body_html: Hey, I got a quick question regarding the Realism Compatibility Patch of this mod. Does it just edit the weapons stats & info to fit into the Realism Mod, or does it also add the weapon into the Realism Mod’s Bot Loadout System?

comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html:
The compat patch adds the weapon into the stat system so that it performs properly.

It cannot be easily added to Realism bot loadouts without the changes being overwritten after each update of Realism. We’d have to edit realism’s actual loadout json file.

comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html:
I responded to one of these on another thread. You don’t need to spam this on each one.

I assure you I can see your comment.

Changing these to true wouldn’t make much of a difference. It’s more for testing purposes on our end. Hence, they are left false. The weapon already has a chance to spawn in containers due to the way we coded it. This is just an overwrite system in case you wanted it to spawn 100% of the time. etc

comments.author: Fegeer
comments.body_html:
Tron

Hey, my apologies for the spam, and many thanks for your reply! Out of curiosity, how did you set up the distribution of the new items to loot pools? I assumed it was done by SPT automatically if the item was in the handbook. Or do you guys have a dedicated config for that? I did look and I found only the piece of code I pasted above. Thanks!

comments.author: Tron
comments.body_html: Our method of coding the item into the database is by cloning an existing item and then making our changes to make the item unique. In this case, we left the loot distribution of the said item unchanged.
